examples.en: She wants to travel around the world.
We travelled to Xi'an by train.

mnemonic.tip: travel by train/bus/plane：用 by 说交通方式，不加 a/the。

examples.en: Our class went on a trip to the museum.
examples.zh: 我们班去博物馆参观了。

examples.en: Have a good trip!

mnemonic.tip: school trip 学校出游；go on a trip 去旅行——trip 多指短途。

examples.en: The journey to the coast takes three hours.
examples.zh: 去海边的旅程要三个小时。

examples.en: How was your journey?

mnemonic.tip: journey 强调路上的过程：a long journey 漫长的旅途。

examples.en: Where did you go on holiday?
The summer holidays start in July.

mnemonic.tip: holi(holy神圣)+day→过去的节日都是宗教日，后来变成假期；on holiday 在度假。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the Great Wall.
The tourists took lots of photos.

mnemonic.tip: tour(游览)+ist(人)→到处游览的人，就是游客。

examples.en: We visited the science museum.
examples.zh: 我们参观了科学博物馆。

examples.en: My aunt is visiting us this weekend.
examples.zh: 我阿姨这周末来看我们。

mnemonic.tip: visit 后面直接加地点或人：visit the zoo / visit Grandma，不加 to。

examples.en: We stayed at a hotel near the beach.
examples.zh: 我们住在海滩附近的酒店。

examples.en: The hotel has a big swimming pool.

mnemonic.tip: stay at a hotel 住酒店；重音在后：ho-TEL。

examples.en: My suitcase is full of presents.
examples.zh: 我的行李箱装满了礼物。

examples.en: He can't close his suitcase.

mnemonic.tip: suit(套装)+case(箱子)→装衣服的箱子，就是行李箱。

examples.en: You can leave your luggage at the hotel.
examples.zh: 你可以把行李寄存在酒店。

examples.en: How much luggage do you have?

mnemonic.tip: luggage 不可数：一件行李是 a piece of luggage。

examples.en: Show your passport at the airport.
Don't forget your passport!

mnemonic.tip: pass(通过)+port(港口)→通过港口海关的证件，就是护照。

examples.en: Look at the map to find the hotel.
There is a map of the town at the station.
Two tickets to London, please.
I bought the film tickets online.
We returned home at ten o'clock.
A return to Cambridge, please.
examples.zh: 请来一张到剑桥的往返票。

mnemonic.tip: re(回)+turn(转)→转身回去；买票时 single 单程，return 往返。

examples.en: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
examples.zh: 我们提前两小时到了机场。

examples.en: The airport is far from the city.

mnemonic.tip: air(空中)+port(港口)→空中的港口，就是机场。

examples.en: The plane took off on time.
Have you ever been on a plane?

mnemonic.tip: plane 是 aeroplane 的简称；by plane 坐飞机。

examples.en: Birds fly south in winter.
We flew to Sanya last year.
examples.zh: 去年我们坐飞机去了三亚。

mnemonic.tip: fly→flew→flown；fly a kite 放风筝也用它。

examples.en: Our flight leaves at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 我们的航班早上六点起飞。

examples.en: The flight to Shanghai takes two hours.
examples.zh: 飞上海的航班要两小时。

mnemonic.tip: fly 的名词是 flight，gh 不发音：一次飞行就是一个航班。

examples.en: The train station is near the market.
I'll meet you at the station at nine.

mnemonic.tip: train station 火车站、bus station 客运站、police station 警察局。

examples.en: The train leaves from platform three.
Wait on the platform behind the yellow line.

mnemonic.tip: plat(平的)+form(形状)→平平的一块地方，就是站台。

examples.en: The train to Beijing is very fast.
We caught the last train home.
examples.zh: 我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

examples.en: The railway goes through the mountains.
We live near the railway station.

mnemonic.tip: rail(铁轨)+way(路)→铁轨铺成的路，就是铁路。

examples.en: I take the bus to school.
The bus was full this morning.

mnemonic.tip: by bus 坐公交；get on/off the bus 上/下车。

examples.en: The bus stop is outside the bakery.
We waited at the bus stop for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我们在公交站等了十分钟。

mnemonic.tip: bus(公交)+stop(停)→公交车停的地方，就是公交站。

examples.en: Let's take a taxi. It's raining.
The taxi stopped at the hotel.
examples.zh: 出租车停在了酒店门口。

mnemonic.tip: taxi 音译"的士"：广东话"的士"就是 taxi。

examples.en: Dad washes the car on Sundays.
We went to the countryside by car.
Mum drives me to school on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天妈妈开车送我上学。

examples.en: He drove too fast and got a ticket.

mnemonic.tip: drive→drove→driven；driver 就是 drive 的人。

examples.en: I go to school by bike.
Her new bike has a basket.
examples.zh: 她的新自行车有个车筐。

mnemonic.tip: bike 是 bicycle 的简称：bi(两)+cycle(轮)→两个轮子的车。

examples.en: My uncle rides a motorbike to work.
Motorbikes are faster than bikes.

mnemonic.tip: motor(发动机)+bike(自行车)→带发动机的自行车，就是摩托车。

examples.en: Always wear a helmet on your bike.
examples.zh: 骑自行车一定要戴头盔。

examples.en: His helmet is bright yellow.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"海梅特"：像海螺一样扣在头上的帽子，就是头盔。

examples.en: We rowed a boat on the lake.
The fishing boat came back at noon.

mnemonic.tip: boat 小船，ship 大船：湖上划 boat，海上开 ship。

examples.en: The ship crossed the sea in two days.
We saw a big ship at the port.
examples.zh: 我们在港口看到一艘大船。

examples.en: The boat sailed slowly down the river.
We learned to sail at summer camp.
examples.zh: 我们在夏令营学了帆船。

mnemonic.tip: sail 和 sale(特卖)同音：帆船起航，商店起卖。

examples.en: The ferry takes cars across the river.
We took the ferry to the island.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"摆渡"的"费里"：坐渡轮要付一点费。

examples.en: Can you ride a horse?
She rode her bike to the park.

mnemonic.tip: ride→rode→ridden；骑车骑马都用 ride，开车才用 drive。

examples.en: The road to the village is narrow.
Be careful when you cross the road.

mnemonic.tip: road 是城外的公路，street 是城里两边有房子的街道。

examples.en: The old bridge crosses the river.
We took photos on the bridge.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"布里奇"：桥像一条布带，把两岸连在一起。

examples.en: The traffic is heavy in the morning.
Stop when the traffic lights are red.

mnemonic.tip: traffic lights 红绿灯、traffic jam 堵车——traffic 家族常客。

examples.en: Dad stopped to buy petrol.
The car is nearly out of petrol.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 petrol，美式 gas；petrol station 加油站。

examples.en: The train arrives at half past two.
We arrived in Beijing at night.

mnemonic.tip: arrive in+大地方(城市国家)，arrive at+小地方(车站学校)。

examples.en: The bus leaves in five minutes.
I left my umbrella on the train.

mnemonic.tip: leave 两义：人离开，东西被留下——人走了东西留下了。

examples.en: Hurry, or we'll miss the train!
examples.zh: 快点，不然要错过火车了！

examples.en: I miss my grandparents a lot.

mnemonic.tip: miss 两义：错过车，想念人——都是"没抓住"的感觉。

examples.en: We caught the early train.
Catch the ball with both hands.

mnemonic.tip: catch→caught；catch a bus 赶车，catch a ball 接球，catch a cold 感冒。

examples.en: Is this seat free?
He gave his seat to an old lady.
examples.zh: 他把座位让给了一位老奶奶。

mnemonic.tip: seat 里有 sea 和 eat：坐着看海吃东西，好座位。

examples.en: The bus can carry forty passengers.
examples.zh: 这辆公交能载四十名乘客。

examples.en: All passengers must wear seat belts.
examples.zh: 所有乘客必须系安全带。

mnemonic.tip: pass(经过)+enger(人)→坐车经过的人，就是乘客。

examples.en: We built sandcastles on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在海滩上堆了沙堡。

examples.en: The beach is crowded in August.

mnemonic.tip: beach 和 peach(桃子)一字之差：海滩上吃个桃子真惬意。

examples.en: Her brother studies abroad.
Have you ever been abroad?

mnemonic.tip: a+broad(宽广)→去更宽广的世界，就是出国；go abroad 前不加 to。

examples.en: The countryside is quiet and green.
examples.zh: 乡下又安静又绿意盎然。

examples.en: We cycled through the countryside.

mnemonic.tip: country(乡村)+side(地带)→乡村地带，就是郊外。

examples.en: The camping trip was a real adventure.
examples.zh: 那次露营真是一场冒险。

examples.en: He loves reading adventure stories.

mnemonic.tip: ad(去)+vent(来到)→主动走向未知，就是冒险；本 App 就叫 Adventure English！

examples.en: The guide showed us the old castle.
examples.zh: 导游带我们参观了古堡。

examples.en: I bought a guide book about London.
examples.zh: 我买了一本伦敦旅行指南。

mnemonic.tip: guide 带路的人或书：tour guide 导游，guide book 指南。

examples.en: Send me a postcard from the seaside!
examples.zh: 从海边给我寄张明信片！

examples.en: The postcard shows the Great Wall.

mnemonic.tip: post(邮寄)+card(卡片)→能直接寄的卡片，就是明信片。

examples.en: A bike has two wheels.
The big wheel at the funfair is fun.
examples.zh: 游乐场的摩天轮很好玩。

mnemonic.tip: wheel 和 we+eel(鳗鱼)：轮子转起来像滑溜溜的鳗鱼。big wheel 摩天轮。

examples.en: The lorry carries fruit to the market.
A big lorry blocked the road.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 lorry，美式 truck；KET 用英式。

examples.en: The bakery has a little white van.
examples.zh: 面包店有一辆白色小货车。

examples.en: They moved house with a big van.
examples.zh: 他们用一辆大货车搬了家。

mnemonic.tip: van 比 lorry 小：送货小面包车是 van，大卡车是 lorry。

examples.en: The underground is the fastest way in London.
We took the underground to the museum.
examples.zh: 我们坐地铁去了博物馆。

mnemonic.tip: under(下面)+ground(地面)→地面下跑的车，就是地铁；伦敦人也叫它 the Tube。

examples.en: The plane landed safely at nine.
Frogs live on land and in water.
examples.zh: 青蛙生活在陆地和水里。

mnemonic.tip: 飞机 take off 起飞，land 降落——落到 land(陆地)上。

examples.en: The school is two kilometres from my home.
We walked five kilometres today.

mnemonic.tip: kilo(千)+metre(米)→一千米，缩写 km；英式拼 metre。

examples.en: The beach is about three miles away.
examples.zh: 海滩离这儿大约三英里。

examples.en: They drove two hundred miles in one day.
examples.zh: 他们一天开了两百英里。

mnemonic.tip: mile 和 smile 差个 s：多走一 mile，多一个 smile。1 英里≈1.6 公里。

examples.en: The bus stops outside the school.
Get off at the next stop.

mnemonic.tip: stop doing 停止做某事；the next stop 下一站。

examples.en: We stayed at my aunt's house.
Stay here. I'll be back soon.

mnemonic.tip: stay at a hotel 住酒店，stay with friends 借住朋友家。

examples.en: Pack your bag the night before the trip.
examples.zh: 出发前一晚收拾好行李。

examples.en: She packed a towel and a swimsuit.

mnemonic.tip: pack a bag 打包行李；packet(小包)就是 pack 出来的。

examples.en: We went on a tour of the old town.
The band is on tour this summer.

mnemonic.tip: tour 转一圈的游览：tourist(游客) 和 tour guide(导游) 都从它来。

examples.en: She speaks two foreign languages.
Foreign visitors love this old street.
examples.zh: 外国游客喜欢这条老街。

mnemonic.tip: foreign 的 g 不发音：/ˈfɒrən/；foreign language 外语。

examples.en: The Nile is the longest river in the world.
examples.zh: 尼罗河是世界上最长的河。

examples.en: I want to see the world one day.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天能看看世界。

mnemonic.tip: in the world 世界上——最高级句子的标配：the best in the world。

examples.en: The rocket flew up into space.
He made a paper rocket at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校做了一个纸火箭。

mnemonic.tip: rocket 里有 rock(岩石)：火箭冲天像巨石飞上天。
